base.make_ahead: Toss the wings in the baking powder mix up to 1 day ahead and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry; bake and glaze on the night

steps.text: Toss the wings with the baking powder, paprika and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey, soy and vinegar until sticky.
Toss the hot wings in the glaze and return to the oven.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets and toss in the flour whisked with the water, paprika and salt.

base.make_ahead: Wings can be dried a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and leave them uncovered in the fridge, ideally overnight. Season with salt.

Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for the dip. Serve with celery sticks.

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets and whisk the flour with 2 teaspoons each of the paprika and garlic powder, salt and the water into a thick batter.
